environment: Node built-in test runner; minimal DOM and injected RPC/wallet mocks; real bundled ethers ABI tuple encoding/decoding and hashing
coverage: A token address can match multiple registered supply or watched-balance monitors; choosing a result loads its exact registered ID and watched account
A watched wallet matches its balance monitor while preserving the token source address; a pool address loads its pool monitor and raw reserve facts
Invalid, zero and unregistered addresses clear prior report/evidence, selected identity, consent and quote; paid estimate and send stay blocked without a current selection
Any partial registry read error or a registry count above 256 fails closed without selecting a partial match or retaining stale prior results
Freshness badges use the stored report observation timestamp and RPC head time, including a stale report, rather than the browser clock or lookup time
The address form and tracked example buttons use public reads only, with no wallet access, fee estimation, registration, funds request or pending transaction journal
The browser action default is captureAndAnalyze; security fixtures explicitly select snapshot where needed so all 16 prior approval/recovery cases remain meaningful

All existing wallet identity, actual RPC chain, runtime/model/dependency pin, fresh quote, explicit consent, exact budget, durable recovery, ambiguous error, reconciliation, nonce race and submission fee headroom tests still pass
The 48 existing gas, generation-client, original agent UI and standalone portrait/page tests remain passing
limits: These deterministic semantic mocks are not browser-extension or funded-wallet QA; browser and live deployment verification are separate
Lookup only discovers subjects already registered in the pinned observations contract; no arbitrary address registration or analysis was performed by these tests
No new mainnet deployment, public RPC request, funded inference or signed transaction was performed by this suite
Historical validation reports were left unchanged
